us.label: US News
us.subtitle: Top domestic headlines from the last 1–2 days

articles.title: AP-NORC poll finds Americans blame Trump for high prices
bullets: Most Americans disapprove of Trump’s handling of the economy.
About six in 10 Republicans disapprove of cost-of-living handling.
Rising prices are shaping the midterm election environment.

articles.title: Trump and Vance campaign in heavily Republican areas before midterms
bullets: Trump and JD Vance are campaigning Thursday in deep-red states.
The appearances aim to boost Republican enthusiasm before November.
Trump is scheduled for events in Alabama and Oklahoma.

articles.title: US unemployment claims fall to lowest level since mid-July
bullets: Weekly jobless claims dipped to 197,000.
AP reported layoffs remain low across the economy.
The data suggested continued job security for many workers.

articles.title: Hegseth announces new US drone command and general-officer cuts
bullets: Defense Secretary Pete Hegseth announced a new drone command.
He also said 20% of generals and admirals would be cut.
The Pentagon cited lessons from Ukraine’s battlefield drone use.

articles.title: Trump plans Choctaw Nation rally, a rare presidential visit to Indian Country
bullets: Trump is holding a campaign rally on Choctaw Nation land.
AP noted few sitting presidents have visited tribal nations.
The Oklahoma event comes during the midterm campaign push.

articles.title: Oil rises after China suspends fuel exports
bullets: Reuters reported oil prices rose around 2% Thursday.
Chinese refiners suspended October fuel exports, according to sources.
Brent crude moved back above $100 a barrel.

articles.title: Putin says APEC meeting with Xi can strengthen ties
bullets: Russian agencies reported Putin’s comments on ties with China.
The remarks referenced an APEC meeting with Xi Jinping.
Russia and China continue emphasizing high-level diplomatic coordination.

articles.title: EU cuts aid to Sierra Leone over cocaine kingpin case
bullets: Reuters reported the European Commission suspended financial aid.
The Netherlands cited Sierra Leone’s help to a convicted cocaine kingpin.
The decision adds diplomatic pressure on Freetown.

articles.title: Poland extends German and Lithuanian border controls to March 2027
bullets: Poland will keep controls on its German and Lithuanian borders.
Reuters reported the extension runs until March 2027.
The move affects internal EU border movement.

articles.title: Kasparov says US and Lithuania warned him of assassination threat
bullets: Garry Kasparov said he received warnings from US and Lithuanian officials.
The Kremlin critic described an assassination threat.
Reuters reported the comments Wednesday.

articles.title: Indian pilot praised after Flydubai flight incident
bullets: Reports highlighted an Indian pilot’s role in averting disaster.
The Flydubai flight carried more than 170 passengers.
The incident drew attention to airline security questions.

articles.title: Political dispute grows over changes to voter-registration Form 6
bullets: Indian parties are debating changes to online voter-registration Form 6.
The issue became a major political story Thursday.
The dispute centers on election-process rules and access.

articles.title: India’s Asian Games campaign remains in focus
bullets: India’s Asian Games performance featured among Thursday’s top headlines.
Coverage focused on the country’s ongoing medal campaign.
Sports results remained a leading national story.

articles.title: India highlights new defence-readiness measures
bullets: New defence-readiness measures were among India’s leading headlines.
Reports framed the steps as part of security preparedness.
The story appeared alongside broader national-security coverage.

articles.title: India flags climate and monetary risks to economic outlook
bullets: India’s government warned of risks to the economic outlook.
Climate, geopolitical and monetary pressures were cited.
Reuters reported the comments in a monthly economic report.

articles.title: Micron lifts tech sentiment after earnings
bullets: Yahoo Finance reported Micron earnings boosted tech sentiment.
US stock futures were mixed to start October.
Investors also watched renewed pressure in bond markets.

articles.title: Meta leads high-volume S&P 500 gainers
bullets: Meta rose 3.2% in market-hours trading, StockMarketWatch data showed.
The stock traded 19.3 million shares during the session.
Meta also gained in premarket and after-hours trading.

articles.title: Oracle jumps nearly 4% in S&P 500 trading
bullets: Oracle gained 3.9% during market hours.
Trading volume reached about 40.2 million shares.
The move stood out among large-cap technology names.

articles.title: Apple falls sharply among mega-cap stocks
bullets: Apple dropped 2.7% during market-hours trading.
The stock traded about 27.1 million shares.
It was one of the weaker large-cap tech performers.

articles.title: Lumentum and Marvell post strong semiconductor gains
bullets: Lumentum rose 5.7% in market-hours trading.
Marvell gained 4.5% with heavy volume.
Chip and optical-equipment names outperformed many mega-cap peers.

articles.title: Nuveen completes Schroders takeover, creating $2.6 trillion manager
bullets: Nuveen completed its acquisition of British asset manager Schroders.
Reuters reported the combined group manages $2.6 trillion.
The deal reshapes the global asset-management landscape.

articles.title: ConocoPhillips explores sale of Norway business and UK Teesside asset
bullets: ConocoPhillips is evaluating potential asset sales in Europe.
The review includes its Norway business and Teesside asset.
Reuters reported the exploration of options Thursday.

articles.title: Sanofi expands Regeneron partnership in deal worth up to $8 billion
bullets: Sanofi and Regeneron expanded their partnership Thursday.
Reuters reported the deal could be worth up to $8 billion.
The agreement marks an early win for Sanofi’s new CEO.

articles.title: Tesla September registrations rise across Europe
bullets: Reuters reported Tesla registrations rose in several European markets.
The September data extended the company’s regional recovery.
The rebound followed earlier weakness in European demand.

articles.title: BT revives core brand with launch of BT TV service
bullets: BT launched a BT-branded TV service Thursday.
Reuters described the move as completing a historic brand revival.
The launch updates BT’s consumer entertainment offering.

articles.title: Google launches AI chips into space for Project Suncatcher test
bullets: Google’s experiment sends four TPUs into orbit.
A SpaceX rocket is delivering the Project Suncatcher hardware.
The test supports research into orbital data centers.

articles.title: Apple plans new smart-home hub launch
bullets: A Reuters-cited report said Apple plans a smart-home hub launch.
The device is part of Apple’s renewed home-technology push.
The story featured in October 1 tech-news coverage.

articles.title: FTC AI probes headline US technology-policy coverage
bullets: The CODEW roundup listed FTC AI probes among key tech stories.
The coverage focused on regulatory scrutiny of artificial intelligence.
AI oversight remains a central US technology-policy issue.

articles.title: OpenAI GPT-6.1 Astra appears in October 1 AI roundup
bullets: The CODEW featured OpenAI GPT-6.1 Astra in its tech-news roundup.
The item was grouped with major AI and software developments.
OpenAI remained central to enterprise AI coverage.

articles.title: Nokia and Iceye to build low-orbit satellite systems
bullets: Nokia and Iceye will develop satellite communications systems.
The systems target defence and security customers.
Reuters reported the partnership from Oslo.
